name: superpowers
description: Agentic development methodology: brainstorming, git worktrees, written plans, subagent-driven TDD, code review, branch completion.

bootstrap.note: Vendored by git clone, not by `npx skills add`: that tool writes into every harness directory it knows and writes its own skills-lock.json at the repo root — both are artifacts `skills-cli build` already owns. Verified, not assumed. `npx skills add <repo> --list` remains the way to see what a repository offers.
